# B&B Constro HVAC Solutions Pune

> B&B Constro Private Limited is a leading commercial HVAC engineering contractor based in Pune, Maharashtra, India. Led by Mr. Pravin Bakshi (17+ years HVAC industry leadership with corporate engineering roots at Hitachi, Voltas, and Daikin), the company specializes in commercial VRV/VRF systems, high-tonnage central chiller plants, cleanroom ventilation, 24/7 rapid emergency breakdown repair, and comprehensive Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC).

## Primary Services & Capabilities

- [Commercial VRV/VRF Systems](https://bbconstro.com/services): Turnkey engineering, heat load calculations, and commissioning of energy-efficient variable refrigerant volume systems for corporate IT parks, luxury hotels, and commercial buildings.
- [Central Chiller Plant Systems](https://bbconstro.com/services): Air-cooled and water-cooled screw/centrifugal chillers, primary-secondary variable speed pumping loops, cooling towers, and automated plant room staging.
- [Cleanroom AHU & Air Quality](https://bbconstro.com/services): ISO Class 5 to Class 8 (Class 100 to 100,000) cleanroom validation with 99.99% terminal HEPA filtration, differential pressure cascades, and tight relative humidity regulation.
- [24/7 Emergency HVAC Breakdown & Repair SLA](https://bbconstro.com/services): Guaranteed 60 to 90-minute on-site technician dispatch across Pune and PCMC municipal belts with stocked OEM compressors, relays, VFDs, and mobile diagnostic units.
- [Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC)](https://bbconstro.com/amc): Lifecycle preventive care following a 3-visit annual methodology (2 dry cleaning + 1 high-pressure chemical coil wash) delivering up to 20% electrical efficiency gains.
